parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of layers to return.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the start of the next page of results.

parameters.name: official
parameters.description: Specifies whether the layer is an official layer. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the layer name.

parameters.name: public
parameters.description: Specifies whether the layer is public. Valid values: true and false.
